project_info.theme: Technical fabric showcase for seamless garment construction
project_info.color_palette: White, deep navy blue, charcoal gray, black, with a small red accent

main_subject.detail: A two-panel editorial product poster featuring dark navy textured fabric. The left panel shows folded fabric laid flat in soft overlapping waves. The right panel is a tighter macro view of the same fabric, with a human hand pinching and lifting one corner to reveal thickness, flexibility, and edge finish. Large brand text 'BADASS' appears at the top left. At the lower right panel, a dark gray caption bar with a thin vertical red stripe contains the headline 'CÔNG NGHỆ KEO ÉP NHIỆT', with the subheadline 'THAY CHO CHỈ MAY TRUYỀN THỐNG' below it. Small code 'POHTK724' sits in the bottom-right corner.
main_subject.style: Clean commercial catalog layout, minimal fashion-tech advertising, realistic textile photography, sharp material texture, modern sans-serif typography, high clarity macro detail

composition_elements.text: BADASS; CÔNG NGHỆ KEO ÉP NHIỆT; THAY CHO CHỈ MAY TRUYỀN THỐNG; POHTK724
items: Top Left: large black sans-serif word 'BADASS' on wide white negative space.
Left Side: large rectangular photo block showing folded navy fabric draped diagonally with smooth soft creases against a pale neutral base.
Right Side: taller rectangular macro photo block showing dark navy woven fabric texture with a hand entering from the bottom center-right, pinching and lifting the fabric edge upward.
Lower Right Photo Edge: dark gray horizontal label bar with a thin vertical red stripe on the far left.
Inside Label Bar: white uppercase headline 'CÔNG NGHỆ KEO ÉP NHIỆT' centered across the bar.
Below Label Bar: black uppercase subheadline 'THAY CHO CHỈ MAY TRUYỀN THỐNG' on white background.
Bottom Right Corner: small black product code 'POHTK724'.
Center/Background: clean white poster background with strong margins and asymmetrical editorial spacing.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even diffused illumination, subtle natural shadows in fabric folds and fingers, crisp textile microtexture, neutral commercial atmosphere, no dramatic contrast

technical_specs.render_style: Photorealistic advertising poster, editorial product photography, macro textile detail

assets.name: BADASS wordmark
assets.usage: Attach the BADASS logo reference if exact wordmark fidelity is required for the top-left brand text.

assets.name: navy heat-bonded fabric sample
assets.source: material swatch or close-up product reference
assets.usage: If the fabric weave, coating, edge finish, or exact navy tone must match a real sample, include a close-up material reference image.

prompt_instructions: Use a fabric reference image when the weave pattern and edge construction need to match a real material sample.
If no real product sample is required, keep the fabric generative but preserve the same editorial layout and technical typography.
Preserve Vietnamese headline and subheadline exactly as written.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a technical fabric showcase for seamless garment construction. Clean white background with an asymmetrical editorial layout. Top left features large black sans-serif text 'BADASS'. Left side contains a large rectangular photo of dark navy textured fabric folded into soft diagonal layers on a light neutral surface. Right side contains a taller macro close-up of the same navy woven fabric, with a realistic human hand entering from the bottom area and pinching one corner of the cloth upward to demonstrate flexibility and heat-bonded construction. At the bottom of the right image, place a dark gray horizontal caption bar with a thin vertical red stripe on the left and white uppercase text 'CÔNG NGHỆ KEO ÉP NHIỆT'. Directly below, on white background, add black uppercase text 'THAY CHO CHỈ MAY TRUYỀN THỐNG'. Add small text 'POHTK724' in the bottom-right corner. Emphasize sharp woven textile texture, realistic skin tones, clean catalog styling, soft studio lighting, diffused shadows, photorealistic fashion-tech product photography, macro detail, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
